desc: Quantitative Researchers (QRs) apply rigorous mathematical and statistical techniques to massive datasets to uncover predictive signals (alpha) and design systematic trading strategies.
responsibilities: Develop predictive alpha models using statistical arbitrage techniques.
Research market microstructure and tick-level data.
Design systematic execution logic to minimize market impact.
Collaborate with Quant Developers to deploy models into production.

desc: Machine Learning Engineers bridge the gap between research and production. They are responsible for scaling foundation models, optimizing inference, and building the distributed infrastructure required to train massive neural networks.
responsibilities: Scale foundation models across thousands of GPUs.
Optimize GPU memory kernels for maximum throughput.
Implement novel architectures (e.g., Transformers, MoE) from research papers.

desc: Quantitative Developers (Core Devs) build the ultra-low latency infrastructure that powers algorithmic trading. They focus on hardware-sympathetic programming, kernel bypass, and optimizing code to execute in nanoseconds.
responsibilities: Optimize order routing engines for microsecond/nanosecond latencies.
Build high-throughput market data feed handlers.
Ensure determinism and zero-allocation execution paths.
